Asiwome Ameko is a dedicated Public Health Officer and Medical Statistician based in Tamale, Ghana. With a passion for data-driven healthcare solutions, Asiwome specializes in health information systems, epidemiological research, and health data consulting. He is committed to improving healthcare outcomes through evidence-based strategies and innovative data use
